_comment: Single source of truth for QA rules. Edit here only — qa_validate.py reads this at runtime.
_coherence_check_comment: Per-item coherence between display.summary and the item's combined source_extracts. Verdict: warn when BOTH TF-IDF cosine AND containment fall below their thresholds. Independent signals must agree before flagging. ROUGE-L is recorded per item in qa_bundle.details for diagnostic value but does NOT drive the verdict (brittle n-gram metric that penalizes faithful paraphrasing). Thresholds calibrated against Round-4 Kemah artifact 2026-05-18 — variants A–D pass, variants E–I fail.
_judges_comment: Phase 1 and Phase 2 judges by name. Names resolve via the QA_JUDGES env var (format: name:provider:model,...). Same-family Anthropic (Sonnet Phase 1 + Opus Phase 2 with adversarial system prompt) is the in-Fargate production path — broker proxies Anthropic only, no cross-family egress. Cross-family (Anthropic + Google/OpenAI) is preferred for independent second-opinion when both providers are reachable; deferred until/if a broker route for Google or other providers exists.
_polish_comment: Deterministic regex polish on EO-facing prose. Findings are annotations (never block); the agent reads qa_bundle.json and can fix specific locations via the per-finding 'path' field, then re-run. Patterns are intentionally conservative — false positives are worse than misses for a non-blocking check.

deterministic_checks.description: Every field in spec.identity_fields must be present and non-empty at the top level of the artifact
When briefing_status matches priority_required_status, at least one item must match priority_filter
Every high-weight or blockable claim must carry at least one non-empty source_extract

Every claim (regardless of weight) must carry at least one source_id AND at least one non-empty source_extract. Belt-and-suspenders with high_weight_claims_have_extracts which only covers the high-weight subset. Routes block if any failing claim is high-weight or blockable; annotates otherwise.
Every source_id referenced by a claim must resolve to a source in the artifact's sources[]
Every source must carry non-empty retrieved_text_or_snapshot content
Prose at the paths in prohibited_phrase_paths must not match any pattern in prohibited_phrases (talking_points and other override sections are exempt by being excluded from prohibited_phrase_paths)

Every source_extract on a claim must appear (exact substring or fuzzy match >= substring_check.fuzzy_threshold) in the retrieved_text_or_snapshot of at least one of the claim's cited source_ids. Search is bounded to cited sources only — never wanders. High-weight failures block; lower-weight failures annotate.

Per priority item, summary vs combined source_extracts is scored on TF-IDF cosine AND containment. Warns when BOTH below thresholds in coherence_check (independent signals must agree). Catches summaries that drifted from cited evidence. ROUGE-L is logged per item as info-only.

Artifact must meet the floors declared in spec.completeness (min priority items, min character lengths, min total prose words). Floors are minimums, not goals — most briefings should comfortably exceed them.

Deterministic regex polish on EO-facing prose fields (executive_summary, per-item summary/budget/sentiment summaries, talking_points). Catches doubled words, double spaces, common typos, trailing whitespace. Never blocks; each finding carries a path so the agent can locate and fix it before final write.
